question: Does authentic EMC show a replicated coherent estrogen-response transcriptional state beyond the already published exceptional PGR::NR4A3 case, with a useful implication for which endocrine measurements to test experimentally?
prior_art: Wilbur2022 PMC9489176 DOI10.1200/PO.22.00039: one35F pregnancy-associated cellular EMC TP_2274, PGR::NR4A3, ESR1/PGR/GREB1 narrative outliers, baseline exome-capture RNA before tamoxifen and published >5-year clinical course. No exact index TPMs or serial posttamoxifen molecular assay. Reuse R8 exact primary hashes, all clinical conditions and Table1/narrative distinction. Neither this case nor its reported benefit is a new result.
source_gate: First establish a primary-published fixed estrogen-response gene set, independent authentic tissue measurements and comparators, sex/lineage/batch and overlap metadata. Favor the MSigDB Hallmark early estrogen response established in Liberzon2015 (primary methodology), plus a prospectively separate late-response coherence check, rather than selecting ESR1/PGR exemplars. Do not inspect endocrine expression values before the specific analysis freeze.
addition: An independently replicated multigene transcriptional contrast could justify measuring endogenous ER/progesterone-receptor state and hormone-stimulated outputs in authentic EMC; observational bulk RNA cannot establish dependence, hormone response or benefit.
strongest_alternative: Fusion-associated expression, sex/reproductive state, tissue lineage, stromal mixture, old specimen/FFPE quality and platform/batch generate a score without a malignant-cell endocrine program.
defeat: No independently replicated coherent set contrast versus prespecified malignant sarcomas, sensitivity to one EMC/gene/histology/batch, incongruent early/late sets or inability to distinguish sex/lineage/source artifacts defeats promotion. A failed invented hypothesis alone is not a negative paper.
coverage: All13 Hofvander EMC, all6 GSE24369 plus all identified relevant authentic EMC RNA/IHC/assay conditions and their overlap. No donor/sex/fusion linkage invention. Suitable accessible pending measurements block promotion.
pilot: 25minutes initially;64MiB newly retained raw including copies;>=10GiB free. Larger stage requires lead size/decision notice. Existing raw sources reused in place.
